worlds.title: Backrooms & Liminal
worlds.description: The Backrooms and other liminal, surreal spaces, found-footage storytelling, and environments that feel too familiar to be safe.

videos.title: Backrooms: Lobby Lingerer (V1)
videos.description: After noclipping out of reality, Adam wanders the Backrooms Lobby... but something is different. Version 1.
videos.longDescription: Lobby Lingerer is an early Fiction2Reality Backrooms short centered on an uncanny lobby environment and the feeling that familiar architecture has become subtly wrong.

videos.title: Backrooms: Lobby Lingerer (V2)
videos.description: After noclipping out of reality, Adam wanders the Backrooms Lobby... but something is different. Version 2.
videos.longDescription: Version 2 revisits the Lobby Lingerer concept as Fiction2Reality continues refining the environment, presentation, and atmosphere of the Backrooms-inspired short.
